digest.component_or_area: Store push and initialization with S3 remotes
propositions: S3 remote URLs without a compatible git-remote-s3 helper (version >=0.3.2) cause silent store corruption via multiple bundle files per ref

The preflight guard _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url must detect S3 mode by URL scheme (s3:// or s3+zip://) and raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally before any push, bypassing best-effort semantics
Store initialization at mount-time must fail closed with the actionable error message when sync.remote is an S3 URL without the required helper
Synchronous and async push paths must both call the S3 preflight immediately after URL resolution, before any network I/O or detachment
Non-S3 remotes and unresolvable remote URLs must remain unaffected; the preflight is a no-op for non-S3 schemes and missing URLs preserve existing best-effort skip
The S3 helper requirement must be wired through OptionalDependencyError re-raise in push_after_commit to prevent best-effort exception swallowing from silencing the hard misconfiguration error
